Why bonds belong in your portfolio

Fixed returns, regular payouts and the option to sell on the exchange.

  1. Potentially higher returns

    Depending on the issuer and credit rating, some bonds may offer better coupon rates than traditional Fixed Deposits.

  2. Tradability and liquidity

    Listed bonds can be bought and sold on stock exchanges, which may provide greater liquidity compared to FDs, which are generally locked in until maturity.

  3. Tax benefits on specific bonds

    Certain notified bonds, such as those under Section 54EC (e.g., NHAI, REC, PFC, IRFC), allow exemption from capital gains tax under specific conditions.
